_description: Canonical conformance vectors for the stake-weighted quorum predicate (STAKE_WEIGHTED_QUORUM / WI-1). The predicate's canonical source is xchain-indexer/src/consensus/stake_weighted_quorum.js; the platform's twin reconciler vendors BYTE-IDENTICAL copies into xchain-hub, xchain-explorer, xchain-sdk, xchain-sync and this repo's protocol/reference-impl/consensus/stake_weighted_quorum.js. Each repo's ConsensusPrimitiveConformance test runs these vectors against its local copy AND asserts byte-identity with the documentation copy, so any drift is machine-detectable. A divergence in predicate logic forks the chain. This file is the single source of truth; do not fork it. Predicate: a source-deduped quorum holds iff 3 * sum(distinct signing-source weight) > 2 * S, where S = sum of weight over distinct sources; pubkeys are matched case-insensitively. Fail-closed rules: a blank or missing source fails closed; a MISSING or nonnumeric weight fails closed (totalStake throws), because zeroing it shrinks S and lowers the very 2/3 bar it is measured against (#3897) - an explicit '0' is still legitimate; a NEGATIVE weight anywhere in the snapshot fails closed (totalStake throws); a non-positive total stake S is never quorate.

meetsStakeThreshold.name: single source meets the threshold (3S > 2S)
empty signer set fails (0 > 0 is false)
two of three equal sources fail the strict 2/3 boundary (60 > 60 is false)
all three equal sources pass (90 > 60)
three of four equal sources pass (>2/3)
two of four equal sources fail
source dedup: two keys of one source count that source once (insufficient)
pubkey match is case-insensitive
a duplicate signer pubkey is counted once
an unknown signer pubkey is ignored, not counted
blank source fails closed even though it would otherwise pass
weighted: one heavy source alone exceeds 2/3 of total (300 > 240)
decimal weights: fractional stake math is exact (4.5 > 3.0)
negative weight fails closed: a corrupt row cannot buy quorum for an otherwise-passing signer
negative weight fails closed: an EMPTY signer set must not finalize against negative S (0 > 2*S regression)
negative weight fails closed even when the remaining positive stake alone would pass
all-zero weights: S is not positive, nothing is quorate even with every source signing
a TRUNCATED snapshot fails closed even when the un-truncated set would be quorate (stake-eviction / silent-drift guard)
a missing weight fails closed: it must not shrink S and lower the 2/3 bar
a null weight fails closed for the same reason
a nonnumeric weight fails closed (bcnum would silently zero it)
an explicit zero weight is still legitimate and does not fail closed

totalStake.name: sums weight over distinct sources (first weight per source wins)
a blank source throws (a collapsed bucket is meaningless)
a negative weight throws (S over a corrupt snapshot is meaningless)
a TRUNCATED snapshot throws (dropped sources make the sum meaningless)
a missing weight throws (zeroing it would silently lower S)
a nonnumeric weight throws (bcnum would silently zero it)
an explicit zero weight is legitimate and sums normally
